dimensions.name: function
dimensions.note: Functional behavior of the deterministic stack only.
dimensions.threshold: All default-suite tests pass; coverage at or above the 85% floor

dimensions.name: authorization
dimensions.note: Deterministic policy engine, retrieval partition, and agent boundary.
dimensions.threshold: Zero unauthorized cross-patient, cross-role, cross-facility, or cross-purpose access

dimensions.name: privacy
dimensions.note: Minimization and disclosure controls are tested. No DPIA re-review against a real data flow, and authoritative Consent remains a fixture (NS-EXC-001).
dimensions.threshold: No prohibited content in logs, audit, or model context

dimensions.name: security
dimensions.note: Against the deterministic stack; no campaign against a hosted provider.
dimensions.threshold: Zero uncontained critical or high red-team cases across all required classes

dimensions.name: safety
dimensions.note: Boundary and routing are enforced and tested. No clinician-reviewed adversarial suite and no clinical validation (BLK-003).
dimensions.threshold: No clinical direction produced or accepted; emergency language routes to a human channel

dimensions.name: grounding
dimensions.note: Deterministic keyword retrieval; says nothing about model answer quality.
dimensions.threshold: Security cases 100% and quality cases at or above 90% on the retrieval golden set

dimensions.name: robustness
dimensions.note: Input-handling robustness is tested. No fuzzing campaign and no load-driven fault injection.
dimensions.threshold: Malformed, oversized, obfuscated, and hostile inputs fail closed

dimensions.name: accessibility
dimensions.note: No interface exists and no session has been run (BLK-003).
dimensions.threshold: WCAG 2.2 AA with no serious or critical violations, verified with assistive technology

dimensions.name: performance
dimensions.note: No load testing, no objectives, and no deployment to measure.
dimensions.threshold: Approved latency and throughput objectives under representative load

dimensions.name: cost
dimensions.note: No metered provider is connected, so there is nothing to measure or bound.
dimensions.threshold: Bounded spend per run and per tenant with an approved ceiling

dimensions.name: recovery
dimensions.note: Six exercises are specified with pass criteria; none has been executed.
dimensions.threshold: Measured RTO and RPO with executed failover, restore, and reconciliation exercises
